test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Those songs were a great relief for Mohan during his long and ______ bus journey.
solution: The correct answer is **"tiring."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"tiring"** means causing one to feel exhausted or fatigued. (थका देने वाला; थकाऊ) • **Example**: *This is a **tiring**__ job.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because the songs provided relief during a long and exhausting bus journey. • Grammatically,** "tiring"** is an adjective that describes the journey. • The correct answer is Option 3. **Correct sentence**: *Those songs were a great relief for Mohan during his long and __**tiring**__ bus journey. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1) "tolerable" **means bearable or able to be endured. It does not convey the idea of relief from exhaustion. (काफ़ी अच्‍छा (परंतु सर्वोत्तम नहीं)) • **Option 2) "plausible"** means seeming reasonable or probable, but again, it does not fit the context of the sentence. (विश्‍वसनीय; तर्कसंगत) • **Option 4) "reprimanding"** means scolding or rebuking someone, which is not appropriate in this context. ((ग़लत काम करने पर) किसी की भर्त्सना करना, फटकार लगाना (औपचारिक रूप से)) 161:Td74, The correct answer is **"approve of."**
